# Mr Md Zaker Ullah FRCS — Consultant Oncoplastic Breast Surgeon, London & Essex

> Consultant oncoplastic breast and general surgeon in London and Essex. Clinical Lead of the Whipps Cross Breast Unit, Barts Health NHS Trust. Private practice at The Harley Street Clinic, Nuffield Health at St Bartholomew's and Nuffield Health The Holly Hospital. GMC 4368515. Rated 5.0/5 from 22 verified reviews on iWantGreatCare. Private secretary: 020 8936 1263.

## Treatments
- [Breast lumps & pain](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/benign-breast-conditions/): One-stop assessment of new breast symptoms
- [Breast cancer surgery](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/breast-cancer-surgery/): Oncoplastic conservation, mastectomy, lymph nodes
- [Breast reconstruction](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/breast-reconstruction/): Implant, flap, nipple and symmetry surgery
- [Breast reduction](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/breast-reduction/): Reduction mammoplasty & symmetrisation
- [Breast augmentation](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/breast-augmentation/): Implants for size, shape or symmetry
- [Fat grafting (lipofilling)](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/fat-grafting/): Refining shape with your own tissue
- [Gynaecomastia (men)](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/gynaecomastia/): Male breast assessment & reduction
- [Hernia & gallbladder](https://www.drzakerullah.com/procedures/general-laparoscopic-surgery/): Keyhole general surgery
